sources.use: Attribution of eggs requires evidence; this is an unassigned teaching concept.

sources.title: AMNH: Follow the Fossil Specimen
sources.use: Context for adults associated with nests, not a measurement source.

design_notes: This is not a woven bird nest and is not attributed to any dinosaur species or museum animal.
The open center, unequal pair angles, and two collapsed rim sectors prevent a mechanical egg ring.
Egg number, shell color, dimensions, and arrangement are artistic simplifications, not a specimen reconstruction.
recognition_features: Two collapsed rim sectors and open center

scientific_scope.en: Evidence-informed stylized teaching/environment concept; not a species, specimen, or site reconstruction.
scientific_scope.zh: 有依据的风格化教学或环境概念；不是具体物种、标本或地点的科学复原。

provenance.geometry: Original procedural geometry with manually designed profiles and arrangements.
provenance.author: Leon Made This / s010s

budget_note: T2 rather than the initial T1 nest target: editable, recognizably elongated eggs retain broad ten-sided facets.

description.en: An unassigned dinosaur egg-nest teaching concept with a shallow earthen basin, two low rim sectors, and eight elongated eggs in four loose pairs.
description.zh: 不指定物种的恐龙卵窝教学示意：浅土窝、两处低边和四组疏松配对的八枚长卵。

author: Leon Made This / s010s
